verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a quickstart that completes a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox using Airwallex.js and the hosted payment page. It also offers instant self-serve sandbox signup, pre-built Hosted Payment Page and Drop-in Element integrations with a documented createElement(...) call, and an `airwallex-dev` skill that generates integration code. Nothing in the evidence shows copy-paste samples across multiple server languages or SDKs, or that the flow can actually be built in under a day. Missing for 10: multi-language copy-paste code examples or SDKs, hands-on or independent time-to-integrate corroboration.
